label: Caller-stream mapped gather for one-token inputs
hypothesis: Reduce b1 mapped scheduling CPU overhead (diagnostic nonconsumer0.060064ms/call, before-first-consumer0.047555ms) by removing copy-stream context and entry dependency. Lost gather/QK overlap may offset improvement.
change: Mapped bulk at one total input token only uses caller compute stream. Wait for previous consumed event before output reuse; synchronize gather-completion event before returning to preserve host table and ID lifetime. Keep other mapped/pipeline/bulk paths and buffers unchanged.
tradeoffs: Removes gather/QK overlap at one token
Must synchronize gather completion only, not full caller-stream compute
Preserve previous-consumed event dependency for different caller streams
Shared-host prefill integration deferred until this isolated schedule validates
confirmation_rule: Unchanged complete-screen nomination, exactly3 fresh balanced blocks, fixed Holm family, signed95% regression guards; no optional extension.
